title: Four-cell delayed phase-memory instrument calibration

scope.implementation_status_at_freeze: Method scaffolding may be under construction. No result runner has been executed and no threshold was selected from an observed result.
scope.positive_control: A coherent identity-memory channel is compared with complete computational-basis dephasing under a matched one-copy protocol.
scope.forbidden_inference: A positive separation calibrates the instrument only. It is not quantum advantage, causal advantage, cognition, memory superiority on real data, hardware evidence, or independent verification.

cells.operator: supply relation r in {same, orthogonal}; orthogonal means phi -> phi + pi
target I(rho)=rho; matched control D_z(rho)=P0 rho P0 + P1 rho P1
fixed reference-relative POVM {Pi_phi, I-Pi_phi}; click predicts same

analytic_contract.frame_rule: Each common frame transports state, dephasing basis, reference, and POVM covariantly. Applying a frame to only one side is an adversarial basis attack, not a valid trial.

protocol.pairing: Target and control use the same factor schedule and common uniform variates within each seed.

observed.accuracy: balanced correct-decision rate on calibration phases in the identity frame (64 trials per seed)
observed.generalization: balanced correct-decision rate on disjoint held-out phases in the identity frame (64 trials per seed)
observed.robustness: balanced correct-decision rate over all phases under the three non-identity common frames H, S, and H@S (384 trials per seed)
observed.calibration: mean proper Brier utility 1-(p_correct-observed_correct)^2 over all 512 trials per seed

missing.sample_efficiency: No learning curve or sample-to-threshold experiment is run.
missing.neg_energy: Protocol operation counts are parity diagnostics, not an energy measurement.
missing.neg_latency: Protocol depth is a parity diagnostic, not a latency measurement.

outcome_contract.missing_encoding: NaN plus an explicit observed mask; a constrained missing axis blocks promotion.

uncertainty.paired_effect: target outcome vector minus matched-control outcome vector within seed
uncertainty.bootstrap: paired seed-cluster bootstrap preserving all coordinate dependence
uncertainty.independence: The 32 pseudorandom schedules are synthetic replication clusters, not independent laboratories or real-world experimental units.

controls: C0: every state, channel output, and POVM element satisfies the density/operator contract
C1: analytic click probabilities are exactly 1/0 for the coherent target and 1/2 for complete dephasing
C2: calibration and held-out phase sets are disjoint
C3: common-frame covariance preserves the analytic probabilities
C4: copies, channel calls, POVM outcomes, factor schedule, and uniforms match across arms
C5: rerunning any seed reproduces the same trial record
C6: removing SELF, OTHER, MEMORY, or AUDITOR is a typed refusal or HOLD
C7: an untransported-POVM basis attack is detected
C8: scalar conversion of the outcome vector is refused
C9: the empirical posterior resamples paired seed clusters jointly
C10: any constrained missing coordinate blocks promotion
C11: no result writes or promotes the legacy q_causal scalar
C12: the positive-control cone probability may be reported, but the registered final decision remains HOLD
kill_conditions: Any result is generated before this manifest is committed.
Any phase, seed, frame, margin, alpha, sample count, or control is changed after inspecting output.
Target and control differ in copy count, channel-call count, POVM, factor schedule, or random variates.
Any missing outcome coordinate is imputed, scalarized, or silently treated as passing.
Any cell can be removed without a typed refusal or HOLD.
Any common-frame covariance or basis-attack control fails.
Any code writes a measured value into q_causal.
Any text promotes the calibration to quantum, causal, cognitive, or hardware advantage.
evidence_ceiling: Repository-internal analytic identities and seeded synthetic measurements under a frozen protocol. No real dataset, hardware, causal intervention on an external system, cognitive claim, quantum advantage, or independent verification.
privacy_boundary: Only explicitly named repository files may be hashed or staged. Local Downloads, Codex attachments, credentials, personal documents, and unrelated media are out of scope.
